protocol.same_sampling: All methods share within-seed time partitions, supervised minibatches, PDE collocation points, and initial-condition points.
protocol.same_residual_operator: JAX autodifferentiation of the solution for u_t, u_x, and u_xx in every method.
protocol.pca_fit_scope: The PCA basis uses training times only; a full basis is computed once per seed and truncated for the k sweep.
protocol.parameter_matching: Each PCA MLP hidden width is selected to keep its parameter count within 5% of the base network.
protocol.validation_and_test: Validation metrics are tracked at checkpoints. Test metrics are calculated only at the final checkpoint (maximum configured step).
protocol.timing: Compilation and validation-function compilation are excluded from timed training and reported separately. PCA pipeline elapsed time includes its training-only SVD/basis construction.
protocol.pde_metric: Validation and final test PDE residual use the same grid finite-difference scoring operator for all models; training residuals use the same JAX autodiff operator.
